title: Objectwise scalar-unit-normalized finite tensor realization
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $T$ on which $\ell$ is invertible, and $n,d\in\mathbf N$. Let $A=\mathcal O_E/\pi_E^{n+1}$ with the universe lift used for fixed-coefficient module sheaves. Let $F$ be the canonical realization from fixed $A$-module sheaves to modules over the constant ring sheaf, with scalar-unit section $\eta_M$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $L$ be the degree-$d$ finite intrinsic twisting line [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] and $L^{\mathrm{fix}}$ its constant-scalar restriction [def-pur-finite-tate-site-comparison]. For each fixed-coefficient sheaf $M$, there exists an intrinsic-module isomorphism $F(M)\otimes L\simeq F(M\otimes_A L^{\mathrm{fix}})$ sending every local tensor $\eta_M(x)\otimes y$ to $\eta_{M\otimes L^{\mathrm{fix}}}(\mu(x\otimes_A y))$, where $\mu$ is the specified lax tensor map of sheaf inclusion. This asserts a single component; its naturality and the uniqueness of the natural transformation are separate conclusions.

proof.text: Restrict the intrinsic line to constant scalars. The canonical module sheafification adjunction identifies its associated intrinsic realization with the original line, with the counit composed with the scalar unit equal to the identity on sections. The constant scalar unit is locally bijective, so constant-scalar balancing and intrinsic balancing agree locally.

proof.text: Tensor the realization units and use the sectionwise tensor and sheafification universal properties. The lax tensor map of fixed-module sheaf inclusion becomes an isomorphism after sheafification. Compose with the preceding identification of the second factor. Naturality of the sheafification unit gives exactly the displayed pure-tensor equation. The inverse is the map induced by the same pure tensors in the other presentation; the two composites fix pure tensors and hence are identities. Zero rings and empty objects need no additional assumption.

        sfIntrinsicRealizationUnit T (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))
          (M ⊗ finiteTateProSheaf l E n T d) W
